title: VendorSchemaMapping
description: Configuration blob stored in the schema registry container as '{vendorId}-{schemaVersion}.json'. Defines how a vendor CSV maps to the platform canonical model.

VendorId.description: Vendor identifier matching the VendorId in DatasetAvailableEvent.

SchemaVersion.description: Schema version matching the SchemaVersion in DatasetAvailableEvent.

Encoding.description: File encoding. Only UTF-8 is accepted; non-UTF-8 files are dead-lettered.

ColumnMappings.description: Ordered list of vendor-to-canonical column mapping rules.

VendorColumn.description: Column name as it appears in the CSV header row (case-insensitive match).

CanonicalField.description: Platform canonical field name used in CanonicalRecord.Fields and the Parquet output column.

DataType.description: Target data type for parsing and Parquet schema generation.

UnitConversion.description: Optional unit conversion applied to numeric values during transformation.

MinValue.description: Optional lower bound for numeric range validation (FR-010). Only evaluated for decimal/double/float fields. null means no lower bound.

MaxValue.description: Optional upper bound for numeric range validation (FR-010). Only evaluated for decimal/double/float fields. null means no upper bound.

RequiredFields.description: List of VendorColumn names that must be non-null and non-empty in every record. Records missing any required field are rejected.
